title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up for elevated blood pressure.

HPI
Mr. Smith presents today for follow-up regarding his blood pressure management. He reports adherence to his prescribed antihypertensive medication regimen at home. He states that his diet has been stable, and he denies any recent increases in stress or anxiety levels. He reports no new symptoms or changes in his usual routine since his last visit.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily
Amlodipine 5 mg daily

Exam
Vitals: BP 134/82 mmHg, HR 78 bpm, RR 16/min, Temp 98.6°F. Lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally. Cardiovascular exam reveals regular rate and rhythm with no murmurs, rubs, or gallops appreciated.

Assessment
Hypertension, managed.

Problem List
Major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate.

Plan
Continue current antihypertensive regimen. Encourage continued monitoring of dietary sodium intake. Follow up in three months or sooner if blood pressure readings become significantly elevated.
explanations: Depression appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
